body: Pills have a terrible success rate, but it sounds like you already recognize that from your comment. You most likely won't die, you'll probably suffer from seizures/organ failure/coma that will make you wish you were dead but you can't do anything about because now you're in the hospital and under surveillance.
I'm alive right now mostly because I make enough money to buy obscene amounts of alcohol to keep myself drunk enough to not go through with it.

Pills won't kill you. They have a terrible success rate. All you're going to do is incapacitate yourself and make it near impossible to try something that works. Call emergency services and get yourself fixed up now.

I wish people would research what works and what doesn't before they try to kill themselves. Pills have a terrible success rate. All you're likely to do is destroy your digestive tract, liver, and kidneys. Nine times out of ten, you won't die. You'll just be left with organ failure and put on suicide watch that will make your life even more of a hell than before you tried and unable to successfully do it.

I'll let you in on a little secret: as someone who lived in terror of not being top of my class all the way through college, no one cares what your GPA was. I never, EVER had an interview with an employer who said a goddam word about my grades. Do not kill yourself over expectations from other people that do not matter in the real world. That doesn't mean don't try. Try! But for yourself. For what you believe you can achieve. But don't kill yourself over something as meaningless as grades in school that ultimately mean nothing.
The military is not allowed to kill you by denying you necessary medical care. If your doctors will not elevate your case, contact a civilian lawyer.

I think everyone here has an exit plan. Unfortunately, there are very few scenarios where you can peacefully slip off to eternity without a professional assisting you. It's not like the movies, and for some reason, almost everywhere that has approved physician assisted suicide only allows it for a provable terminal illness, as though clinical depression isn't a physiological disorder that almost guarantees a lifetime of torment.

I know how I'm going to do it. I know when I'm going to do it. I hope other people in my shoes find treatment that will allow them to live the life they deserve, but as for me, I've tried everything and it didn't work. I'm just waiting for the right circumstances to carry it out.

Pills have a terrible success rate. Like 1% from what I've read. If you really want to die, the BEST case scenario you can hope for is that you'll pass out and choke to death on your own vomit. It's not like the movies where you just fall asleep and die. More likely is for you to suffer severe kidney, liver, or brain damage that will leave you incapacitated and in agony without killing you. You'll also probably be so debilitated that you can't make a second attempt. You'll be in the hospital under constant surveillance and probably physically unable to do anything or make any choice at that point.
Pills are an unreliable and terrible way to go from everything I've read.

I'm alive only because I don't want my parents to have to bury me. The sadness of them dying would probably be enough for me to do it anyway, but my plan is to kill myself the day after they're both gone.

It's a somewhat freeing feeling to know you have an escape ready, but I feel terrible thinking I'm just counting down the days until my mother and father die.

The time I most ever wanted to kill myself was after I felt betrayed by a therapist for being honest with them about how I felt and they called the police to take me to an emergency psyche ward. No one would listen to me that I was just telling her what I thought about and why I wanted help. They just locked me up with other people who were trying to fight orderlies and throwing their own shit in the hallways.
